name: 79 - Core - Check Communication Permission - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS channel,
        $4::TEXT AS purpose,
        $5::TIMESTAMPTZ AS requested_at,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS request_reference
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name,
        patient.mobile,
        request.channel,
        request.purpose,
        request.requested_at,
        request.request_reference
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.clinic_id = clinic.id
       AND patient.mobile = request.mobile
    LIMIT 1
),

consent_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(
                consent.consent_type,
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'status',
                        CASE
                            WHEN consent.expires_at IS NOT NULL
                             AND consent.expires_at <= NOW()
                                THEN 'expired'
                            ELSE consent.status
                        END,
                    'policy_version',
                        consent.policy_version,
                    'granted_at',
                        consent.granted_at,
                    'revoked_at',
                        consent.revoked_at,
                    'expires_at',
                        consent.expires_at
                )
            ),
            '{}'::JSONB
        ) AS consents
    FROM patient_consents consent
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON consent.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND consent.patient_id = context.patient_id
),

preference_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        TO_JSONB(preference) AS preference
    FROM patient_communication_preferences preference
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON preference.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND preference.patient_id = context.patient_id
       AND preference.channel = context.channel
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN 'communication_context_loaded'
        ELSE 'patient_not_found'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT ROW_TO_JSON(context)
        FROM patient_context context
    ) AS patient_context,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT consents
            FROM consent_snapshot
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS consent_snapshot,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT preference
            FROM preference_snapshot
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS preference_snapshot

FROM request_data request;

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS clinic_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS patient_id,
        $3::TEXT AS channel,
        $4::TEXT AS purpose,
        $5::TEXT AS decision,
        $6::TEXT AS decision_reason,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '')::TIMESTAMPTZ
            AS next_allowed_at,
        $8::JSONB AS consent_snapshot,
        $9::JSONB AS preference_snapshot,
        NULLIF($10::TEXT, '') AS request_reference
),

inserted_check AS (
    INSERT INTO communication_permission_checks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel,
        purpose,
        decision,
        decision_reason,
        next_allowed_at,
        consent_snapshot,
        preference_snapshot,
        request_reference
    )
    SELECT
        request.clinic_id,
        request.patient_id,
        request.channel,
        request.purpose,
        request.decision,
        request.decision_reason,
        request.next_allowed_at,
        request.consent_snapshot,
        request.preference_snapshot,
        request.request_reference
    FROM request_data request
    RETURNING *
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'communication_permission_saved' AS result,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_check
    ) AS permission_check_id,

    (
        SELECT decision
        FROM inserted_check
    ) AS decision,

    (
        SELECT decision_reason
        FROM inserted_check
    ) AS decision_reason,

    (
        SELECT decision = 'allowed'
        FROM inserted_check
    ) AS allowed,

    (
        SELECT decision = 'deferred'
        FROM inserted_check
    ) AS deferred,

    (
        SELECT next_allowed_at
        FROM inserted_check
    ) AS next_allowed_at

FROM request_data request;

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{success:false,result:'invalid_request',message:'اطلاعات بررسی مجوز پیام نامعتبر است.',errors:$json.errors||[]}}];

parameters.content:
## کنترل قطعی مجوز پیام

قواعد بررسی‌شده:
- رضایت تماس
- رضایت مخصوص هدف پیام
- فعال بودن کانال
- ساعات سکوت بیمار

خروجی allowed، blocked یا deferred است.
